reasoning_content:
Let me focus on getting the installation to succeed. The problem is the `geocoder.throttle` service not existing. Let's understand why. The geocoder module's services file defines it, but the module isn't installed/enabled at the time openculturas_openstreetmap is installed. Wait, notice that geocoder is not in the install list in profile/openculturas.info.yml under `install:`? Actually it is at line 108. But `openculturas:openculturas_openstreetmap` isn't in the install list! Wait, openculturas_openstreetmap appears in core.extension.yml but not in profile info install list. Hmm let me check.

Actually the error occurs when installing openculturas_openstreetmap via ConfigImporter (config-based install). The module geocoder is enabled in core.extension. The issue: during config import, extensions are installed in order sorted by weight, and geocoder has weight 0 same as openculturas_openstreetmap. Sort uses reverse alphabetical within same weight... The module list from `getList()` uses sort values. Let me think: modules installed sorted by `sort` descending? Actually installation order: arsort by sort value, then within same sort, the original order. The changelist starts as array_keys(diff) which follows core.extension.yml order? Actually `$new_extensions['module']` preserves config order (alphabetical from core.extension.yml). Then `$install` is in that order. Then arsort($install_required) etc — arsort preserves key order for equal values (PHP sort is not stable but asort/arsort... in PHP 8 sorts are stable). So modules with sort 0 remain in alphabetical order. geocoder comes before openculturas_openstreetmap alphabetically, so geocoder should be installed first.

But the install failed at openculturas_openstreetmap. Maybe geocoder itself didn't install. Look: at line 174 geofield installed. After that openculturas_address_links, ... but no "geocoder module installed". So geocoder was never installed! And no key, ctools, oauth2_client either. Wait, those aren't in log either. Let me check: grep for "key module", "ctools module", "oauth2_client module".

Hmm, only 102 modules installed out of many in core.extension. Notably geocoder, ctools, key, oauth2_client, openculturas_map, openculturas_openstreetmap, openculturas_slimselect, simplei... wait simplei was installed. Let me check which modules in core.extension were NOT installed. The installation stopped at openculturas_openstreetmap presumably.

Actually geocoder should have been scheduled for install before openculturas_openstreetmap. Since it failed on openculturas_openstreetmap with geocoder.throttle missing, maybe geocoder was installed but its services weren't found because...? Actually if geocoder was installed, the service would exist. Unless the module's services file failed to load because the Stiphle library isn't autoloaded... no, the service definition would still be registered.

Wait — in Drupal, module services.yml files are only loaded when the module is enabled. During the module install within config import, when installing openculturas_openstreetmap, it calls updateKernel which rebuilds container including all enabled modules. If geocoder was already enabled, its services.yml would be loaded. 

Let me look more carefully: is geocoder listed in the install but its install failed silently? Let me grep the log more thoroughly around lines 100-125 (start of installs) to see beginning.

Actually the installs shown start with "mysql system user path_alias..." Let me see the full list of installed modules and compare to core.extension enabled modules.

action.command: cd /workspace; grep -oE "\] [a-z_0-9]+ module installed" /tmp/drush_si2.log | sed 's/\] //;s/ module installed//' | sort > /tmp/installed.txt; sed -n '3,250p' config/sync/core.extension.yml | grep -oE "^  [a-z_0-9]+:" | sed 's/  //;s/://' | sort > /tmp/enabled.txt; echo "=== enabled but not installed ==="; comm -23 /tmp/enabled.txt /tmp/installed.txt | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "counts:"; wc -l /tmp/installed.txt /tmp/enabled.txt
